column2: All right! Now Mazinger Z can get into the castle!
Storming the castle!
Oh no!
Hmph, figured it was going too easy!
But if we don't do something, we're in trouble...!
Damn...!!
Whoaaa!!
It's terrible, Professor Yumi!\n\nMazinger Z has been captured by the enemy!
And the assault team...!?
We've lost contact with the assault team too!
No...
We must think of a countermeasure quickly... It's a grim situation, but you must not leave here under any circumstances! It would be walking right into the enemy's trap.
It's a grim situation, but you must not leave here under any circumstances! It would be walking right into the enemy's trap.
The rioters have appeared!\n\nThey're marching on this hotel!
So they've finally come... Honey-kun! Take {p}-kun somewhere safe!
Let's go, {p}-kun!
B-but...!
We're going!
Listen up! Don't you dare leave this room! I'm going back to Professor Yumi. When new information comes in, I'll come tell you, so be a good boy!
All right! We held off the enemy's first wave! But there's no doubt the next one's coming! Don't let your guard down, everyone!
{p}! What are you doing out here!? If the Demon King takes you, all our efforts go down the drain!
...Sorry.
No! Go back to your room!!
Go back to your room, {p}-kun! If anything changes in the battle, I'll be sure to tell you!
So you came here after all...
How did you know?
Who can say...?\n\nNever mind that, come this way... I have something to give you.
This is the key to the basement.\n\nThrough the basement's drainage system, you can get outside Science City... Go! To the Hill of Beginnings!!
Through the basement's drainage system, you can get outside Science City... Go! To the Hill of Beginnings!!
I finally found the exit!
Heh heh heh... The Demon King's been waiting for you!
Now the world will go back to how it was...!\n\nSun of rebirth! Come with us to the Hill of Beginnings!!
Sun of rebirth! Come with us to the Hill of Beginnings!!
What's the matter, {p}?
Guard-san! Look at that!
...They've come to fetch you. Let us go together, to the Demon King!
Not on my watch!
Honey!
You're such a handful, {p}-kun! Get it together a little more!
You'd interfere!?
Honestly, what a hopeless boy! Come on, let's go!
Go? Where?
Isn't it obvious? The Hill of Beginnings!
...Honey!! All riiight, let's go!
Heeey! Wait for meee!
{p}, no leaving me behind!
Sorry, it's not like we forgot you!
All riiight, let's go!
Lucky! This is my newspaper's company car! Let's drive it to the Hill of Beginnings!
That's a good omen!
Yeah!
...What an eerie forest.
I've never been in a forest this creepy...
I've got a bad feeling about this, but we've got no choice but to go through this forest.
This is my school! St. Chapel Academy! Why is my school in a place like this!?
Honey! Look at that!!
Ahahahaha! Burn, buuurn!
Anyone who defies the Demon King dies!
Feel it! The Demon King's wrath!
What are they doing!? We've gotta stop them!
...Natsu-chan! Where's Natsu-chan!?
Right, we've gotta save Natsu-chan!
Natsu-chan! Natsu-chan!
...Ah, Honey!
Hey! The rioters are coming! We've gotta get out of here, fast!
Natsu-chan, stay right here and keep still!
Okay, go get 'em, Honey!
There are too many of them!
Is this the end!?
{p}-kun... I'm sorry. I couldn't keep you safe...
Honey! What are you saying!?
Listen. When I give the signal, take Natsu-chan and run! Honey is going to self-destruct!
No, Honey!
That's right, Honey! Don't give up!
I'm sorry, there's no other way...\n\nSeiji-kun, take care of {p}-kun for me...
Over here! You lackeys of the Demon King, catch me if you can!
Natsu-chan!?
Over here, over heeere!
Natsu-chan! Don't!
Found her!
Fool who defies the Demon King! You won't get away!
KYAAAAAAAA!!
Natsu-chan!?
How could they...!
I won't forgive you!
Natsu-chan... I'm sorry...
No use thinking about it here. Anyway, let's go to the Hill of Beginnings!
...That was how the world is meant to be.
Wh-who's there!?
How the world is meant to be... What do you mean!?
You're a victim of the Dimension Chain too, Honey. What you just saw is something that is going to happen in your world...
What do you mean!? How do you know my name!?
Answer me!!
Could it be... you're {s}!? That's it, right? You're {s}, aren't you!?
No. It isn't {s}. If it were {s}, why wouldn't she show herself!?
Natsu-chan...?
